name: io.github.tevfikefeaydin/agenttoll
description: Pay-per-call market and Base onchain data for AI agents - prices, gas, trending pools, new-token radar, market briefs. Each call paid automatically in USDC on Base via x402 ($0.001-$0.005). No API keys.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: EVM private key of the wallet that pays per call (needs USDC on Base)
